checked.adjudication_refs: Exact packet+recording generation, complete declaration SHA refs, no duplicates, accepted subset/cardinality, distinct alternatives, no unresolved acceptance; external adjudication remains pending. Partial-reviewer role gap recorded separately.
checked.agreement: Only complete exact declared meaning signatures; excludes reviewer ID/time/free notes/source-authority evidence refs; partial declarations retained and not admitted or given complete signatures.
checked.all_masks_zero: Uses unchanged owner _masks; no path writes nonzero masks, targets or admission flags. Full receipt replay rejects changes even after a body re-seal.
checked.declaration_not_authentication: Read evidence pins and closing bytes; identity/independence/source authority/currentness/reviewer blindness/actual adjudication all false; no evidence content interpretation or signature verification.
checked.duplicates: Reject duplicate submission IDs, renamed-identical complete payload bodies, duplicate item per submission, repeated non-null declared reviewer/item IDs, anchor IDs and qualifier attachment IDs/refs.
checked.geometry_separate: Explicit chosen complete normative declaration and evidence; interval geometry only via unchanged packet owner, no flat target construction or semantic admission.
checked.non_normative_absent_rules: Filled non-normative interpretation requires []; normative requires nonempty rules; independent normative eligibility/definition choices are preserved even if contradictory for later adjudication.
checked.partial_null_vs_explicit_absence: Missing_fields include only None review/context questions; explicit []/empty allowed strings are filled declared absence; no null-to-empty conversion. Evidence/exposure can remain unanswered because completeness means filled annotation slots, never authentication.
checked.unicode_coordinates: Source-role/trigger coordinates use selected-source Unicode; section-boundary coordinates use full raw-section Unicode plus exact artifact. Literal selectors checked.

findings.description: Declared adjudicator overlap is checked only against complete review declarations. A non-null reviewer_id in a partial declaration for the same item is absent from that set and can be submitted as adjudicator on another complete declaration.
findings.impact: Does not authenticate, resolve or admit any label because all flags/masks stay false/zero, but weakens declared-role separation and conflicts with the recorded-reviewer-ID rejection wording.
findings.required_correction: Consider every non-null recorded reviewer_id for the physical item; add an inert test combining a complete first review with a named partial second review and naming that second reviewer as adjudicator.

limitations: Static review only; inert tests not executed by reviewer.
Caller-supplied reviewer/adjudicator IDs and timestamps are declarations; no authentication or independence proof.
Raw archival views/provenance revalidation does not reopen original374MBexport or establish official current law.
Geometry applies to supplied literal anchor intervals; declared normalized/paraphrased rule atom text is not equated with anchor surfaces, nor is role semantics reviewed.
Completeness refers to filled review/context slots; identity/process/exposure evidence may still be absent, and all masks remain0.
Exact agreement is conservative and includes ordered anchor/attachment metadata; it is not semantic equivalence.
Dictionary API cannot verify original submission file bytes or recover duplicate keys discarded before invocation; strict parse_json_bytes is supplied for file callers.
Resolver behavior and original producer computation are not cryptographically attested.
method: Read complete recorder and inert tests, compare delegated packet/geometry contracts and closed constants; AST parsing only. No subject import or tests.
